Building the MCP for Voiden, the API IDE we open sourced a year ago almost. Added the ability to test APIs through AI also create MCP. Basically going headless

mentions.name: Voiden
mentions.description: Voiden is an API tool that has just released community plugins, letting anyone build plugins to extend and grow the tool's functionality without bloating the core product. Plugin-building documentation is provided at docs.voiden.md.
mentions.problem: The API tool could become bloated with new features, so growth is instead delegated to community-built plugins.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Today I released the community plugins for Voiden.

This is a big one because one of the things I dont want is the API tool to become bloated with new features - so I want to allow anyone to build plugins to grow the tool.
